description: Native 68k port of the Fallout 1 Community Edition engine by DJBase (amigaworld.de) - RTG via cybergraphics, AHI audio, MVE movies, optional Apollo AMMX acceleration. Ships the engine, a ReAction settings tool and dat1-extract; you supply the original Fallout game data.
name: Fallout 1 CE (68k)
notes: Early debug build (author: not fully optimised yet). Requires original Fallout 1 data files (~300 MB extracted), an RTG board with cybergraphics.library v40+, FPU, and 8-16 MB fast RAM.
